jobs.title: Security Patrol Officer - Variable Schedule
jobs.company: Union Gospel Mission of Tarrant County
jobs.description:
More than a career...it's a calling!


Founded in 1888, Union Gospel Mission of Tarrant County is a united Christian organization and ministry dedicated to providing love, hope, respect, and a new beginning for homeless women, men, and families. UGM-TC is funded entirely by the generosity of the community and offers a residency program for individuals looking to maximize their potential and transition out of homelessness. Through the programs and services provided, individuals develop essential life skills to become independent, productive members of our community. UGM-TC is God’s healthy place to end homelessness one person at a time. Come serve with us!  




UGM is seeking a flexible Security Patrol Officer able to work a variable schedule regarding hours and days worked based on the organization's changing needs.






Position Summary:


The selected individual will patrol and secure assigned premises as well as identify and mitigate risks to staff and patrons. We are looking for active, dependable individuals that are highly motivated. Former military or law enforcement experience preferred! This position requires individuals to stand/walk for extended periods of time. There will be routine checks and code compliance requirements for the 10-acre campus of Union Gospel Mission of Tarrant County.  We also service The Vineyards of Lancaster, registering visitors, taking calls, and ensuring visitors have registered vehicles while conducting routine patrols. 


What You Do: 



  • Patrol buildings and grounds. 

  • Maintain campus security and follow lock protocols. 

  • Provides individual and group escorts to and from parking areas. 

  • Identifies and removes unauthorized individuals from property. 

  • Enforces campus parking policies/cites violations. 

  • Executes Courtesy Patrol policies, procedures, and standards with excellence. 

  • Provides campus directions to facility visitors. 

  • Interacts with police, fire personnel, EMS, patients, visitors, and staff. 

  • Completes incident / offense reports and composes narratives by performing investigations, recording observations, taking statements, gathering information, citing occurrences, and utilizing surveillance activities.  

  • Make eye contact and greet all people with respect. 

  • Responds to calls for service and emergency situations with urgency and professionalism. 

  • Assesses the situation and utilizes appropriate de-escalation measures. 

  • Utilizes critical thinking skills. 

  • Responds to and activates the appropriate emergency response codes.  

  • Supports activities and events by utilizing appropriate crowd control techniques representative of UGM.  

  • Work overnights, weekends, evening hours, and holidays as needed by the organization.  

  • The central job functions of this position are not limited to the duties listed above. 


 


Qualifications / What You Bring:  



  • 3-5 years of security, law enforcement, or military experience preferred. 

  • Familiarity with security equipment.

  • Ability to handle physical workload (walking/standing)

  • Bilingual:  Spanish Speaking a plus

  • Level 2 License preferred

  • Strong attention to detail 

  • An ability to connect with people from diverse backgrounds at varying levels of understanding.  

  • Problem Sensitivity — The ability to tell when something is wrong or is likely to go wrong. It does not involve solving the problem, only recognizing that there is a problem. 

  • Deductive Reasoning — The ability to apply general rules to specific problems to produce answers that make sense. 

  • Flexibility of Closure — The ability to identify or detect a known pattern (a figure, object, word, or sound) that is hidden in other distracting material. 

  • Inductive Reasoning — The ability to combine pieces of information to form general rules or conclusions (includes finding a relationship among seemingly unrelated events). 

  • A clean driving record.






“As part of the screening process, you may be asked to provide a pastoral reference. Union Gospel Mission of Tarrant County is a Christian organization that seeks to hire people who align with our beliefs in Jesus Christ. We welcome all Christian denominations into the mission.”

jobs.title: Loss Prevention Teammate - 2nd Shift
jobs.description:
At DICK’S Sporting Goods, we believe in how positively sports can change lives. On our team, everyone plays a critical role in creating confidence and excitement by personally equipping all athletes to achieve their dreams. We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workforce, reflecting the communities we serve.

If you are ready to make a difference as part of the world’s greatest sports team, apply to join our team today!

Overview

2nd Shift Opportunity

Monday - Thursday

4:00pm-2:30am

$20.05/hr + $1.00/hr shift differential

Job Duties & Responsibilities

Inventory Integrity, shrink control and profit protection.

  • Conduct and assist in internal investigations (theft, dishonesty, policy violations, human resources) in the DC.
  • Conduct and assist with external investigations related to cargo theft to and from the DC’s.
  • Complete daily, weekly, monthly & quarterly audits
  • Conduct lane inspections/ carton scans to improve operational accuracy and document in LPMS / DSGiQ (case management systems)
  • Compile and reconcile data for Seal Verification reporting.
    • Researches, resolves and documents discrepancies.
  • Review inventory adjustment details in order to research high dollar losses.
  • Complete store research to identify & resolve misdirected freight issues.
    • This includes variance investigations for DC & field related issues.
  • Partner with Federal Authorities in relation to Firearms control and reporting.
Report all findings to database, email contacts and immediate alerts if within criteria.

Safety and Emergency Preparedness

  • Work closely with Operations & Leadership team to investigate incidents which includes document review, visual inspections. Clearly communicate findings with internal & external stakeholders.
  • Serve as support for potentially volatile terminations and /or situations within location.
  • Supports accident investigations with video review and detailed reporting.

Conduct weekly / monthly / quarterly Safety Assessments to ensure overall safety compliance and reports findings.

Physical Security and Investigations

  • Responsible for security screening all people entering/exiting the facility per DSG requirements.
  • Test, troubleshoot and respond to all alarm systems (burglar, Fire & Amarok [perimeter electrified fence])
  • Opening/Closing of DC facility per DSG guidelines without supervision
  • Complete building walkthrough multiple times throughout daily shift
    • Focusing on misdirected freight, safety, physical security, firearm security, & deterrence
  • Knowledge of Genetec system, create access control badges & ensure all building credentials are accurate.
  • Complete daily observations of facility and document /address opportunities.
Conduct and / or support investigations in regard to concerns or violations of the physical security of assigned location and report findings.

Yard Management

  • Assist guard shack as needed with inbound/outbound trailer procedures. Provide physical control of guard shack and perform duties for emergency coverage if / when needed.
  • Resolve daily logs to allow proper YMS (Yard Management System) workflows to be followed.
  • Assist with passive yard control requests.
  • Reconcile Yard Audit results to ensure yard accuracy.
  • Provide direction to 3rd party staff.

Conduct and / or support investigations in to concerns or violations of trailer yard of location and report findings.

Other

  • Conduct Social Engineering Drills with the stores on a regular basis.
  • Assigned schedule can be temporary / permanently changed as needed for the needs of the business.
  • Help maintain inventory of LP Supplies & distribute store orders.
  • Serve as resource/provide guidance to warehouse teammates for a variety of topics.
  • Must be available to be on call during off hours.
  • Must be flexible to cover additional hours to provide support during special projects and facility overtime.
  • Assist in New Hire orientation for Loss Prevention introduction for new Teammates.
  • Support other departments in investigations, presence or as needed. i.e., Human Resources, Operations, Logistics.

Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or Equivalent
  • 1-3 years experience
  • Loss Prevention, Asset Protection, Profit Protection, Operations, Safety, Logistics
  • Ability to stand, bend, stoop, reach, push, pull and lift 10-50 pounds intermittently.
  • Basic English reading comprehension & numerical reasoning skills.

Virtual Requirements

At DICK’S, we thrive on innovation and authenticity. That said, to protect the integrity and security of our hiring process, we ask that candidates do not use AI tools (like ChatGPT or others) during interviews or assessments.

To ensure a smooth and secure experience, please note the following:

  • Cameras must be on during all virtual interviews.
  • AI tools are not permitted to be used by the candidate during any part of the interview process.
  • Offers are contingent upon a satisfactory background check which may include ID verification.

If you have any questions or need accommodations, we’re here to help. Thanks for helping us keep the process fair and secure for everyone!

jobs.title: Security Officer Access Operations
jobs.description:
Overview

Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

Job Description

As a Security Officer Access Operations in Ennis, TX, you will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Healthcare, and more. As an Allied Universal Security Professional, you will support a healthcare location by managing access control, monitoring entry points, verifying credentials, and maintaining a professional presence that helps to deter incidents. You will interact with patients, visitors, and staff while providing exceptional customer service and clear communication. Join a caring, agile, reliable, and innovative team that puts people first, delivers through teamwork, and acts with integrity.

Position Type: Full Time

 Pay Rate: $16.53 / Hour

Job Schedule

DayTimeMon10:00 PM - 06:00 AMTue10:00 PM - 06:00 AMSat10:00 PM - 06:00 AMSun10:00 PM - 06:00 AM

What You'll Do

  • Provide customer service to patients, visitors, employees, and vendors by carrying out site-specific security-related procedures, access-control policies, and emergency response activities at a healthcare location.
  • Monitor access points and verify authorization for entry, assisting with visitor screening, credential checks, and directing individuals to appropriate areas.
  • Respond to access-control alarms, incidents, and critical situations in a calm, professional, problem-solving manner, following established site procedures.
  • Maintain accurate security-related logs and reports for visitor activity, access-control events, incidents, and unusual conditions.
  • Conduct regular and random patrols of assigned interior and exterior areas, including entrances, restricted areas, and the business perimeter, to help deter unauthorized access.

Minimum Requirements

  • Comfortable using a computer or tablet is preferred.
  • A guard card/license is preferred.
  • Customer service experience is preferred.
  • At this site there are limited on-site facilities such as portable toilets and rustic guard shacks.
  • Be at least 18 years of age for unarmed roles; 21+ years of age for armed roles.
  • Possess a high school diploma or equivalent.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a background investigation in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws.
  • Allied Universal will consider qualified applications with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable laws.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a drug screen to the extent permitted by law.
  • Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment.
  • A valid driver’s license will be required for driving positions only.

Why Join Us

  • Smart Tools: Access to our exclusive technology to view and claim additional shifts to earn more.
  • Career Growth: Get paid training and access to career growth opportunities.
  • Financial and Health Benefits: Enjoy access to a retirement savings plan, plus medical, dental, vision, basic life and AD&D, and disability insurance.
  • Exclusive Perks: Enjoy discounts on top brands and services through our Perks Program.

Closing

Allied Universal® is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, age, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status or relationship/association with a protected veteran, or any other basis or characteristic protected by law. For more information: www.aus.com.

If you have difficulty using the online system and require an alternate method to apply or require an accommodation, please contact our local Human Resources department. To find an office near you, please visit: www.aus.com/offices.

Job Description and Responsibilities

Become part of one of the largest and fastest-growing privately held security companies in the U.S! Since 1998, Sunstates Security has built a national reputation for delivering exceptional services while fostering high-quality work environments for our team. We are dedicated to hiring, developing, and retaining a professional workforce that reflects our commitment to excellence.

We believe in strategic reinvestment in our people by offering a benefits package that exceeds industry standards, pathways for career advancement, extensive internal training, and employee recognition programs. Our team members are provided with the tools, knowledge, and hands-on management support necessary for long-term success.

Our commitment to a superior workplace culture is reflected in our most recent national accolades. Sunstates Security is proud to be recognized as a 2026 Forbes Dream Employer, an honor based on independent employee feedback and workplace excellence. Additionally, we have been named a 2026 Training MVP by Training Magazine, marking the third consecutive year we have accepted this prestigious recognition. We also continue to be celebrated for our steady growth and stability on the Inc. 5000 list of America’s fastest-growing private companies.

At the heart of everything we do are our core values of honor, integrity, and trust. If you are searching for a rewarding career with a proactive security partner that protects some of the country’s leading organizations, we invite you to explore the possibilities at Sunstates Security. Join a successful, growing team where your talent is appreciated and have opportunities to advance your professional career.

HIRING IMMEDIATELY

Sunstates Security is hosting a Hiring Event for Armed Security Officers on Wednesday, August 26, 2026, from 9:30AM -2:00PM.

Meet with Hiring Managers to explore Full-Time, Part-Time, and Flex positions on 1st, 2nd, and 3rd shifts in the Dallas, Texas area.

Various days and shifts are available with a pay range of $21.00 - $23.00/hr, with weekly pay.

{Please keep in mind that in order to attend the 8/26/2026 Hiring Event, you must have a Level III and or Level IV Security License in hand.}

Location of event:

Diversified

8435 N Stemmons Freeway

Suite 100

Dallas, Texas 75247

This is a walk-in event. Come prepared to interview with our hiring managers.



Job Requirements

Requirements:

  • Must have a Valid Texas Level III and or Level IV Security License in hand.
  • Must have reliable transportation to and from work.
  • Must have your own firearm and duty equipment.
  • Must be available to work on Sundays
  • Excellent customer service skills.
  • Security officer and/or military experience is a plus.
  • Good verbal and written communication skills.
  • Willing and able to work holidays and weekends.
  • Ability to pass criminal background and drug screen pre-hire.
  • Willing to work in various weather conditions.
  • Must regularly walk or stand for extended periods of time and distance.

A Security Officer may perform a multitude of duties as specified by the Post Orders and Standard Operating Procedures (SOP). The Security Officer will read and become extremely knowledgeable of Post Orders and SOP and will be able to act quickly and efficiently according to such directives.



Benefits

Industry-leading employee benefits that include weekly pay, 401k savings plan with a company match, affordable medical, dental & vision benefits, employee referral bonuses, paid time off, premium holiday pay, tuition reimbursement, and more – available for qualified candidates!

jobs.title: Dedicated Security Officer - Frisco - Copy
jobs.description:
Dedicated Security Officer - Patrols
Location: Frisco
Compensation: $15.50-$18.00 Per Hour
Schedule: Friday, Saturday | 08:00 PM - 4:00 AM - OVERNIGHT

Must be 19 years of age or older and be able to meet physical requirements
Must have Lvl 2 Guard Card or be willing to obtain it
Must have a 1 driver's license and clean driving record
Must have reliable transportation
Must be able to pass background check


Position Summary:

This role is ideal for individuals who are reliable, observant, customer-service oriented, and motivated to grow within the security industry. Officers will be stationed at one dedicated site and conduct patrols, monitor properties, and provide a visible security presence to help deter criminal activity.

Soft Skills:

  • Visioning: Understanding the big picture and requirements necessary to deliver services that reflect company values, goals, and purpose. Can you exhibit our core values, creating peace of mind for our clients?
  • Strategic Planning: Effective engagement, communication, planning and execution of daily patrol responsibilities while meeting established deadlines. Can you effectively complete a route in the allotted time?
  • Financial Acumen: Understanding company measurements while executing the necessary behaviors to drive performance. Can you manage your time on property which equates with meeting the company benchmark?
  • Team Development: Communicate with Clients, team members and management effectively and in a timely manner, receiving and relaying feedback and executing follow up as needed. Can you work cohesively with a team, delivering on key objectives?
  • Project Management: Complete understanding and execution of daily tasks and efficiently delivering services that meet the needs of the business. Can you complete your daily assigned tasks and communicate maintenance needs of company assets?

Responsibilities:

  • Will conduct and deliver various foot patrols that reflect the company’s values, expectations, and consistent service in alignment with site specific instructions/post orders.
  • Will write detailed and accurate reports utilizing company technology and web or app-based software during each shift that align with site instruction/post orders.
  • The Ability to consistently arrive on time for shifts, clock in and out, meet time commitments, follow instruction, follow dress code and appearance standards and expectations
  • Interacting with internal and external customers on site cultivating a customer service relationship striving to provide peace of mind.
  • Consistently communicates with the Advanced Patrol Guard and or the Branch Patrol Supervisor to ly report any customer or property related information and concerns.
  • Will be assigned a vehicle that guard is responsible for during their shift to include fueling, washing, interior cleanliness, and inspecting.
  • Responsible for the care of any Signal equipment assigned during shift including radios, access keys/cards, uniforms, and devices, etc.
  • Manage daily activities while meeting key benchmarks and expectations set by the Branch Patrol Supervisor such as reporting standards and service quality.
  • Consistently deescalate issues through communication in a professional and manner.
  • Communicate with the Branch Patrol Supervisor to receive and disseminate information through Branch Supervisor Daily Scrum, such as the client needs, route changes, and post order updates to ensure operational excellence and efficiency.

Requirements:

  • 19 years of age or older
  • High school diploma or GED
  • Pass background check and drug test
  • Must have 1 driver’s license and good driving record
  • Must have reliable transportation
  • Complete training modules within first month
  • Excellent organization, oral, and written communication skills
  • Demonstrate a commitment to service, organization values and professionalism through appropriate conduct and demeanor at all times
  • Must be able to move equipment weighing up to 20 pounds

Signal is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

jobs.description:
At Caris, we understand that cancer is an ugly word—a word no one wants to hear, but one that connects us all. That’s why we’re not just transforming cancer care—we’re changing lives.

We introduced precision medicine to the world and built an industry around the idea that every patient deserves answers as unique as their DNA. Backed by cutting-edge molecular science and AI, we ask ourselves every day: “What would I do if this patient were my mom?” That question drives everything we do.

But our mission doesn’t stop with cancer. We're pushing the frontiers of medicine and leading a revolution in healthcare—driven by innovation, compassion, and purpose.

Join us in our mission to improve the human condition across multiple diseases. If you're passionate about meaningful work and want to be part of something bigger than yourself, Caris is where your impact begins.

Responsible for the primary oversight for the operation of the company-wide Corporate Security Operations Center based in Phoenix, AZ or Irving, TX. Perform company-wide security duties including ID badge access control system management, Security Surveillance Video Management System monitoring and investigative reviews, and emergency response for all sites nationally. Provides backup for contract security personnel tasks and duties at the HQ operations.

Job Responsibilities

  • Operates the Corporate Security Operations Center for Caris, working in a global mindset to provide professional security assistance for all of Caris' locations.
  • Performs routine viewing of surveillance monitoring system nationally for all Caris locations and notates and informs the Supervisor and Manager of Corporate Security of any errors or suspicious activity.
  • Creates and assigns permanent and temporary badges nationally for Caris employees, contractors and visitors.
  • Performs reception duties at the front desk when relieving the receptionist.
  • Acts as a first responder to render medical aid and dial 911 in an emergency.
  • Assists in investigate review of video management and badge management systems.
  • Perform patrols of Caris sites, taking notes and observations of hazards, malfunctions or safety / security related issues and contacts the appropriate personnel.
  • Performs clerical duties to assist the Supervisor and Manager of Corporate Security, such as data entry and auditing of Excel spreadsheets.
  • Follow the guidance and instruction from the Supervisor and Manager of Corporate Security.
  • Additional duties as needed and assigned.
  • Reports to Manager, Corporate Security.

Required Qualifications

  • High School diploma or equivalent experience required.
  • Communication - Proficient verbal and written communication skills.
  • Proficient knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite, specifically Word, Excel, Outlook, and general working knowledge of Internet for business use.
  • Drive outcomes based on persistence and passion for excellence.
  • Ability to deal with confidential and sensitive information with tact and diplomacy.
  • Excellent organizational and follow-up skills.
  • Able to maintain timelines of delivery, quality of results, and maintain a calm demeanor in high pressure situations.
  • Ability to work productively and effectively with a wide variety of people, internally and externally.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, specifically Word, Excel, Outlook, and general working knowledge of Internet for business use.

Preferred Qualifications

  • One to three years of security related experience is preferred.

Physical Demands

  • Will work at a computer, perform occasional patrols around multiple sites, up and down stairs and in or outdoors.
  • Must possess ability to sit and/or stand for long periods of time.
  • Must possess ability to perform repetitive motion.
  • Crouching and bending.
  • Capable of lifting 30 lbs.

Training

  • All job specific, safety, and compliance training are assigned based on the job functions associated with this employee.

Other

  • Travel and Response
  • This position requires local travel between sites and some evenings, weekends and holidays.
  • Job may require after-hours response to emergency issues.
  • Periodically scheduled on-call may require after-hours response for technical emergencies not explicitly related to assigned job responsibilities.

Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose.

As a Security Officer Armed Vehicle Patrol Security Clearance in Fort Worth, TX, you will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Aero/Defense, and more.
Join Allied Universal as an armed patrol officer at a leading aerospace and defense location, where you will monitor and patrol assigned areas, remain visible to help deter security-related incidents, and deliver outstanding customer service and communication.
This driving post offers the opportunity to support a dynamic environment with professionalism, teamwork, and integrity while contributing to a caring, reliable, and innovative culture.

Pay Rate: $27.32 / Hour
Job

jobs.title: Security Officer Job at Sundance Square in Fort Worth
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
Job Description
Sundance Square Security is seeking qualified individuals looking for a rewarding career in the heart of downtown Fort Worth.
Our dedicated professionals are committed to the safety of our visitors and businesses.
They are alert, aware and adept at evaluating and responding to situations, and masters of de-escalation.
We welcome all members of our community and visitors who come to the Square to enjoy shopping, dining, and the entertainment.
We enjoy great benefits, a competitive salary and ongoing professional development in a collaborative team culture.
Our Security Officers monitor the properties and protect our valued staff, visitors, tenants, and inventory.
The primary duties of this position include but are not limited to:
* Patrol property on foot and/or bicycle, securing personnel, assets, buildings, gates, and fence perimeter in all weather conditions.
* Respond to alarms and incidents that threaten the safety of others or could harm the properties.
* Investigate and take the appropriate lawfully action as authorized by the corporate policy on accidents, incidents, trespassing, suspicious activities, safety and fire incidents.
* Control and monitor surveillance equipment, and perform building and equipment inspections.
* Guard access points, permitting or refusing entry, restraining trespassers, and direct heavy traffic during start and end of business hours.
* Complete daily reports, including relevant information, observations, surveillance footage, and signatures.
* Secure all doors, windows, and exits, depending on shift.
* Comply with all company policies and all applicable safety rules and requirements.
* Contribute to a positive and inclusive work environment.
* Maintain strict confidentiality regarding security and company procedures.
Company Description
Sundance Square has become a model for urban development, creating a large cultural and economic impact on the city of Fort Worth.
